briefings.takeaway: IMN flips today’s Nicoya Peninsula into afternoon/evening showers and thunderstorms as trades ease and Pacific moisture rises, with heat near 36–37°C. No tropical cyclone near Costa Rica; EPAC development interest stays well southwest of Mexico and farther west, not aimed at Nicoya.

IMN has today quieter with only isolated peninsula showers, then a possible humidity/rain bump into Guanacaste this weekend. No tropical cyclone near Costa Rica; EPAC interest stays well offshore southwest of Mexico and trending west.
